title: The Beautiful Legend of Lugu Lake
synopsis: Learn the origin story of Lugu Lake in Yunnan province.

fullText.simplified:
泸沽湖的美丽传说

    云南的泸沽湖号称高原上的明珠，是中国第三深的淡水湖。这里有着明净的天空，碧蓝的湖水和清新的空气，一切都像是梦幻里的世界。
    关于泸沽湖有这样一则美丽的传说……
    很久很久以前，这里曾是一片乡村。村里有个孩子，从小没有父母。他每天都到狮子山去放牛，人们只要把牛交给他，他总是把牛养得十分肥美。
    有一天，他在一棵树下睡着了，梦见一条大鱼对他说：“善良的孩子，你太可怜了，从今往后，你不用带午饭了，就吃我身上的肉吧。”小孩醒来后，就到山上找啊找，终于在一个山洞里发现了那条大鱼。他切了一块鱼肉烧着吃，味道好极了。第二天，他又去了。那条鱼昨天被切过的地方又长满了肉。就这样，放牛的孩子再也没有饿过肚子。
    不久，这件事被村里一个坏人知道了。他想把神奇的大鱼占为己有，于是约了一些心术不正的人，用绳索把鱼紧紧绑住，然后让九匹马和九头牛一齐使劲拉。鱼被拉出了洞，灾难也同时降临了。湍急的大水从那个洞里喷流而出，一转眼淹没了村子。
    此时，有一个摩梭女人正在喂猪，两个年幼的孩子在旁边玩闹。母亲见大水冲来，急中生智，把两个孩子抱进猪食的大缸子里，自己却淹死了。两个孩子坐在缸子里，随着大水漂流。后来，那两个孩子成了这个地方的开创者，而大水形成了今天的泸沽湖。人们为了纪念那位伟大的母亲，就把此湖也称为“母亲湖”。
    感恩是中华民族的传统美德。我们要感谢父母的养育之情，对父母多一份体贴，多一份关爱。有机会你也可以去云南看一看，感受一下这个美丽传说下的泸沽湖。
fullText.traditional:
瀘沽湖的美麗傳說

    雲南的瀘沽湖號稱高原上的明珠，是中國第三深的淡水湖。這裡有著明淨的天空，碧藍的湖水和清新的空氣，一切都像是夢幻裡的世界。
    關於瀘沽湖有這樣一則美麗的傳說……
    很久很久以前，這裡曾是一片鄉村。村裡有個孩子，從小沒有父母。他每天都到獅子山去放牛，人們只要把牛交給他，他總是把牛養得十分肥美。
    有一天，他在一棵樹下睡著了，夢見一條大魚對他說：“善良的孩子，你太可憐了，從今往後，你不用帶午飯了，就吃我身上的肉吧。”小孩醒來後，就到山上找啊找，終於在一個山洞裡發現了那條大魚。他切了一塊魚肉燒著吃，味道好極了。第二天，他又去了。那條魚昨天被切過的地方又長滿了肉。就這樣，放牛的孩子再也沒有餓過肚子。
    不久，這件事被村裡一個壞人知道了。他想把神奇的大魚佔為己有，於是約了一些心術不正的人，用繩索把魚緊緊綁住，然後讓九匹馬和九頭牛一齊使勁拉。魚被拉出了洞，災難也同時降臨了。湍急的大水從那個洞裡噴流而出，一轉眼淹沒了村子。
    此時，有一個摩梭女人正在餵豬，兩個年幼的孩子在旁邊玩鬧。母親見大水衝來，急中生智，把兩個孩子抱進豬食的大缸子裡，自己卻淹死了。兩個孩子坐在缸子裡，隨著大水漂流。後來，那兩個孩子成了這個地方的開創者，而大水形成了今天的瀘沽湖。人們為了紀念那位偉大的母親，就把此湖也稱為“母親湖”。
    感恩是中華民族的傳統美德。我們要感謝父母的養育之情，對父母多一份體貼，多一份關愛。有機會你也可以去雲南看一看，感受一下這個美麗傳說下的瀘沽湖。

sentences.english: The fish was pulled out of the cave, and at the same time, disaster struck.
Rapid waters jetted out of the cave and flooded the village in the blink of an eye.

sentences.traditional: 此時，有一個摩梭女人正在餵豬，兩個年幼的孩子在旁邊玩鬧。

sentences.traditional: 母親見大水衝來，

sentences.traditional: 急中生智，把兩個孩子抱進豬食的大缸子裡，自己卻淹死了。

sentences.english: The mother saw the waters rushing towards them.

sentences.simplified: 两个孩子坐在缸子里，随着大水漂流。
sentences.traditional: 兩個孩子坐在缸子裡，隨著大水漂流。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge hái zi zuò zài gāng zi lǐ suí zhe dà shuǐ piāo liú
sentences.english: With her quick-thinking, she put the two children in a large vat used to hold pig food. She herself, however, drowned.

sentences.simplified: 后来，那两个孩子成了这个地方的开创者，而大水形成了今天的泸沽湖。
sentences.traditional: 後來，那兩個孩子成了這個地方的開創者，而大水形成了今天的瀘沽湖。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái nà liǎng ge hái zi chéng le zhè ge dì fang de kāi chuàng zhě ér dà shuǐ xíng chéng le jīn tiān de lú gū hú
sentences.english: The two children sat inside of the vat and were carried by the current of the floodwaters.

sentences.simplified: 人们为了纪念那位伟大的母亲，就把此湖也称为“母亲湖”。
sentences.traditional: 人們為了紀念那位偉大的母親，就把此湖也稱為“母親湖”。

sentences.english: Later, the two children became the founders of this place, and the floodwaters turned into today’s Lugu Lake.
In order to commemorate this great mother, people also call the lake “Mother Lake”.

sentences.simplified: 感恩是中华民族的传统美德。
sentences.traditional: 感恩是中華民族的傳統美德。

sentences.simplified: 我们要感谢父母的养育之情，对父母多一份体贴，多一份关爱。
sentences.traditional: 我們要感謝父母的養育之情，對父母多一份體貼，多一份關愛。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men yào gǎn xiè fù mǔ de yǎng yù zhī qíng duì fù mǔ duō yí fèn tǐ tiē duō yí fèn guān ài
sentences.english: Gratitude is a traditional virtue of the Chinese people.

sentences.simplified: 有机会你也可以去云南看一看，感受一下这个美丽传说下的泸沽湖。
sentences.traditional: 有機會你也可以去雲南看一看，感受一下這個美麗傳說下的瀘沽湖。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu jī huì nǐ yě kě yǐ qù yún nán kàn yí kàn gǎn shòu yí xià zhè ge měi lì chuán shuō xià de lú gū hú
sentences.english: We should be grateful for our parents’ nurturing care and show them more consideration and loving care.
If you get the chance, you can also visit Yunnan to see and experience Lugu Lake, the lake of this beautiful legend.

sentence_translations: The Beautiful Legend of Lugu Lake
Lugu Lake in Yunnan province is known as the pearl of the plateau.
It is the third deepest freshwater lake in China.
Here, there are clear skies, dark blue waters, and fresh air. Everything is like it came out of a dream.
Regarding Lugu Lake, there is a beautiful legend that goes like this …
A long, long time ago, this area was rural countryside. In the village there was a child who grew up without parents.
He would go to Lion Mountain to pasture cattle.
People only needed to give their cattle to him, and he would be able to raise them to be fat and plump.
One day, he fell asleep beneath a tree and dreamed of a big fish saying to him,
“Good child, you poor thing. From now on, you no longer need to bring lunch; just eat the meat on my body.”
After the child woke up, he went to the mountain and searched all over. Finally, he found the big fish inside a cave.
He cut a piece of fish meat, cooked it, and ate it. It tasted delicious.
The next day, he went again. The meat on the place where the fish had been cut the day before had grown back fully.
Just like that, the cattle boy never again went hungry.
Not long after, this was discovered by a bad guy in the village.
He wanted to have this magical, big fish for himself.
So, he arranged for some people with evil intentions ..
.. to use a rope to tie up the fish tightly, and then got nine horses and nine cows to pull hard at the same time.
The fish was pulled out of the cave, and at the same time, disaster struck.
Rapid waters jetted out of the cave and flooded the village in the blink of an eye.
Just then, a Mosuo woman was feeding pigs. Two young children were playing beside her.
The mother saw the waters rushing towards them.
With her quick-thinking, she put the two children in a large vat used to hold pig food. She herself, however, drowned.
The two children sat inside of the vat and were carried by the current of the floodwaters.
Later, the two children became the founders of this place, and the floodwaters turned into today’s Lugu Lake.
In order to commemorate this great mother, people also call the lake “Mother Lake”.
Gratitude is a traditional virtue of the Chinese people.
We should be grateful for our parents’ nurturing care and show them more consideration and loving care.
If you get the chance, you can also visit Yunnan to see and experience Lugu Lake, the lake of this beautiful legend.
